messages:
mika_support: Opening thread for a customer escalation. They hit errors and odd scores when trying to stream to /v1/rerank. Ticket INS-4829.
mika_support: Customer client sets `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and sends chunked candidate events; they expect behavior similar to our /v1/generate SSE streaming.
mika_support: Their client logs show: `HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type` and body `{"error":"unsupported content type for rerank"}`.
sam_runtime: FYI @anya_se — rerank was never built for streaming. We validate content-type and require `application/json` with full payload. Gateway returns 415 when CT != application/json.
anya_se: Confirmed. Rerank expects JSON like `{"query":"...","candidates":[{...}]}`. No streaming/ndjson currently. The 415 is from the gateway early, so backend compute isn't reached.
mika_support: Customer provided this repro curl (redacted key):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/event-stream' \
  --data-binary $'event: candidate\ndata: {"id":"1","text":"alpha"}\n\n'
```
mika_support: They told us they were sending candidates one at a time to avoid building a large list client-side. Also reported some returned scores were negative and inconsistent between attempts.
sam_runtime: If they stream per-candidate (and somehow bypassed CT validation), you'd get per-request scoring with different batch contexts -> scores won't be comparable. But since gateway 415s, their client must have retried differently for the scoring anomalies.
anya_se: Negative/extreme scores typically come from scoring normalization against the candidate batch. If the batch size is 1, logits->score mapping and calibration can yield values that look odd when compared to multi-candidate batches.
ops_bot: Gateway log snippet: `time=2026-03-15T12:01:02Z method=POST path=/v1/rerank status=415 ct=text/event-stream req=req_02Gxyz trace=trace-9f3b`.
nora_billing: Billing check requested. If gateway returns 415 before compute, we shouldn't charge. Need request ids to confirm.
mika_support: Provided request ids: req_02Gxyz, req_02Gabc. Customer insists they saw charges on invoice line items referencing rerank. They attached billing invoice.
nora_billing: I'll reconcile. Opening internal ticket BL-1200 to investigate billing entries for those request ids.
anya_se: Short-term proposed actions:
- Improve gateway 415 response body to include clear hint: "Rerank only accepts application/json. Streaming/ndjson is unsupported. Send full candidates array."\n- Add a 400 with explanatory message when `candidates` field missing or not an array.
- Instrument a metric for requests rejected due to streaming content-types so we can measure frequency.
- Add a doc snippet and FAQ entry about batching limits and why streaming breaks relative scores.
sam_runtime: I'll file ENG-RERANK-600 for the gateway/telemetry change and ENG-RERANK-601 for the validation changes in runtime. Also will add a low-risk SDK warning in JS/Python that checks for content-type or suspicious use of chunked transfers.
mika_support: Draft reply to customer: explain rerank is synchronous, request example, explain scoring inconsistency if candidates are sent individually, and offer two options: (1) client-side batching with <=512 candidates per request (our current soft limit) or (2) enterprise workflow: upload candidate file to S3 and call a batch rerank job (requires Dedicated/Private or manual ops assistance).
mika_support: Sample correct request shared with customer:
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "find top help articles",
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"a1","text":"Article A"},
    {"id":"a2","text":"Article B"}
  ]
}
```
anya_se: Customer asked if we could accept ndjson/streaming as a new mode. Short answer: not without redesign. Reranking is O(N) scoring with cross-candidate calibration; streaming would require buffering on server or changing scoring semantics. Possible future feature but not in next quarter.
sam_runtime: For immediate UX: change gateway to return a structured JSON error with `hint` and `doc_url` fields to reduce confusion. Also add a telemetry tag `attempted_streaming=true` when CT indicates streaming.
ops_bot: Created issues: ENG-RERANK-600 (gateway error hint + telemetry), ENG-RERANK-601 (runtime validation & 400 for malformed body), SDK-PR-112 (client-side header warning). Links added to internal tracker.
nora_billing: Billing follow-up: BL-1200 opened, initial check shows gateway 415s for those req ids and no compute charges. I'll update invoice note and close if customer OK.
mika_support: I'll reply to customer with the explanation, examples, and an offer to help modify client to batch. Also give timeline: gateway message update within 3 business days; SDK warning in next release.
anya_se: Also pushing doc change: add bold callout in rerank reference: "DO NOT stream candidates; send a single JSON payload. Streaming leads to unsupported content-type errors and non-comparable scores." 
sam_runtime: I'll assign ENG-RERANK-600 to myself, target patch to gateway tomorrow (nonbreaking). ETA for deploy: 48 hours pending reviews.
mika_support: Thanks all. Setting ticket to waiting-on-customer after sending instructions. :thumbsup:
